title: DAVY'S ON THE ROAD
lyrics_plain:
Davy's on the road again
Wearin' diff'rent clothes again
Davy's pickin' up a buck
To soothe his simple needs
All his goods are sold again
His words as good as gold again
He says: If you see Mina
Ask her please to pity me
Mina, I been running long
Since that day down in the hollow
When my mind went driftin' off
Where my feet were soon to follow
Shut the door, cut out the light
Davy won't be here tonight
You can wait till the dawn rolls in
You won't see Davy again
Davy's on the road again
Wearin' diff'rent clothes again
Davy's turnin' handouts down
To keep his pocket clean
He's sayin' his goodbye again
Wheels are in his eyes again
He says: If you see Mina
Ask her please to pity me
Davy's on the road again
Wearin' diff'rent clothes again
Davy's pickin' up a buck
To soothe his simple needs
All his goods are sold again
His words as good as gold again
He says: If you see Mina
Ask her please to pity me
Blow down to the big towns
They'll set you on your heels
I bought a mouthful of memories
And a lot of stickers for my windshield
Shut the door, cut out the light
Davy won't be here tonight
You can wait till the dawn rolls in
You won't see Davy again
Davy's gettin' older now
His handshake's gettin' colder now
He says: If you see Mina
Ask her please to pity me
Shut the door, cut out the light
Davy won't be here tonight
You can wait till the dawn rolls in
You won't see Davy again
Davy's gettin' older now
His handshake's gettin' colder now
He says: If you see Mina
Ask her please to pity me
